title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 126
description: Ten questions on Psalms 126: the joy of those Yahweh brought back to Zion, and the promise that those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

questions.text: Where had those whom Yahweh brought back returned to?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:1 speaks of "those who returned to Zion."

questions.text: When Yahweh brought them back, what were "we" like?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:1 says "we were like those who dream."

questions.text: What was their mouth filled with?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:2 says "Then our mouth was filled with laughter."

questions.text: What was their tongue filled with?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:2 says "and our tongue with singing."

questions.text: What did they say among the nations?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:2 says they said among the nations, "Yahweh has done great things for them."

answers.text: "Let us go up against them in battle."
"Yahweh has done great things for them."

questions.text: Because Yahweh has done great things for us, what are "we"?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:3 says "Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad."

questions.text: Like what does the psalmist ask Yahweh to restore their fortunes?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:4 says "Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev."

answers.text: Like the streams in the Negev
Like the rain on the hills
Like the dew on the mountains of Hermon

questions.text: What will those who sow in tears do?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:5 says "Those who sow in tears will reap in joy."

questions.text: What does the one who goes out weeping carry?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:6 says he goes out weeping, "carrying seed for sowing."

questions.text: What will he carry when he comes again with joy?
questions.explanation: Psalms 126:6 says he "will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves."
